_readme: SpeakLoop user settings. Copy this file to settings.json in the same directory and edit it by hand; restart the app to apply. Delete a key (or the whole file) to use the built-in default. Keys starting with '_' are ignored and may be used as comments.
_max_record_seconds: Hard limit on a single recording, in seconds (a safety stop). Minimum 1.
_silence_timeout: Seconds of silence, after you have started to speak, before the recording stops by itself. Minimum 0.5.
_silence_threshold: Loudness (RMS, 0..1) above which the microphone counts as hearing speech. Raise it in a noisy room when the recording never stops by itself; lower it when a quiet voice cuts the recording short. Minimum 0.001.
_stt_device: Where speech recognition (faster-whisper) runs: 'auto' (the default) uses the GPU whenever the installed libraries can, whatever the size of the card; 'cuda' and 'cpu' set it by hand. On a small card Whisper takes video memory from the chat model: try 'cpu' when the replies become slow (docs/model-parameters.md, section 3.4).
_accent: Variant of the practiced language: 'american' (the default) or 'british'. It selects the synthesis language code and the list of voices.
_voice: Voice of the partner. It must belong to the variant above: american has af_heart, af_bella, af_nicole, af_sarah, af_sky, am_adam, am_michael, am_echo, am_eric, am_liam; british has bf_emma, bf_alice, bf_isabella, bf_lily, bm_george, bm_daniel, bm_fable, bm_lewis. Remove the key to use the variant default.
_color_theme: UI colors: 'dark' (the default) or 'light'. Each theme is one <name>_schema.json; the shipped ones live in speakloop/themes/, and a file of the same name in config/themes/ wins over them. A color missing from the file falls back to the built-in dark palette.
_first_topic: First topic of the lesson, in your own words (for example 'my morning routine'). An empty value (the default) lets the tutor choose an everyday situation.
_prompt_file: The lesson prompt. Add this key only to try a changed copy of the prompt: with the key absent the app uses speakloop/prompts/free_talk.md. The file must keep its three SETTINGS lines ('Target language: [...]', 'Explanation language: [...]', 'First topic: [...]'), or the app does not start. A relative path is resolved against this directory.
_llm_backend: Which model server the app talks to: 'llama-server' (the default) starts the official llama.cpp binary itself with the GGUF model in models/; 'lm-studio' uses an already-running LM Studio app (see lm_studio_host).
_lm_studio_host: Address of the LM Studio server, used by the 'lm-studio' backend only. Accepts 'host', 'host:port' or a full 'http://host:port' URL; the port defaults to 1234. Point it at another machine to run LM Studio on it.
_llama_server_path: The llama-server binary to start, for a build you manage yourself. An empty value (the default) uses bin/llama/, where 'python -m speakloop.llama_server_fetch' installs it, and falls back to a llama-server on PATH. A relative path is resolved against this directory.
_external_model_path: GGUF model file for the 'llama-server' backend (unused with 'lm-studio'). Add this key only to point the app at a model of your own: with the key absent it finds the downloaded one in models/ by itself. For the smaller fallback model, run 'python -m speakloop.gguf_fetch --fallback' and set this key to '../models/llama-3.2-3b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf'. A relative path is resolved against this directory.
_external_n_ctx: Context window size (--ctx-size) of the local GGUF model. The default is 16384. llama.cpp is told not to shrink it when it fits the model into the free video memory. Minimum 256.
_external_n_gpu_layers: Model layers on the GPU (--n-gpu-layers). 'auto' (the default) lets llama.cpp choose from the free video memory at every start. A whole number (0 or more) or 'all' sets the value by hand and turns that choice off: use it only after you measured your computer (docs/model-parameters.md, section 7.3) and keep at least 500 MiB of video memory free, or the driver silently moves weights to system memory and the answers become much slower.
